Concerns over food-price pressures and inflation continue to influence the Reserve Bank of India's upcoming decision.

articles.title: Dubai seals deal for $159 billion Islamic banking giant
articles.content: Dubai Islamic Bank PJSC will acquire Emirates Islamic Bank PJSC in an all-stock deal to boost its banking presence. The merger will result in the formation of a strong Islamic banking group with substantial assets. This transaction indicates a strategic move to combine corporate and retail banking services effectively. Emirates NBD Bank, the owner of Emirates Islamic, will hold a significant stake in the new entity.

articles.title: Brent trades near month's high as Mideast conflict threatens supply
articles.content: Brent crude futures are close to this month's high due to ongoing conflicts affecting oil exports. Tanker attacks in the Strait of Hormuz and assaults on Saudi energy infrastructure have raised concerns. While Brent crude has seen a slight decline recently, analysts predict it could surpass $100 per barrel. Meanwhile, Ukraine's drone strikes on Russian oil refineries have worsened global fuel supply issues.
